user.title: Connect to Meter MACS
user.description: The Meter MACS portal now blocks automatic sign-in, so sign in at portal.meter-macs.com in your web browser first. Then open the browser's developer tools, go to Application (Storage in Firefox) > Cookies > https://portal.meter-macs.com, and copy the value of the cookie named __Secure-meter-macs.session_token. Paste it below.

reauth_confirm.title: Sign in to Meter MACS again
reauth_confirm.description: The saved portal session for {email} has expired or no longer works. The Meter MACS portal now blocks automatic sign-in, so sign in at portal.meter-macs.com in your web browser first. Then open the browser's developer tools, go to Application (Storage in Firefox) > Cookies > https://portal.meter-macs.com, and copy the value of the cookie named __Secure-meter-macs.session_token. Paste it below.

error.invalid_session: That session cookie did not work. Sign in to the portal again in your browser and copy a fresh one.
error.wrong_account: That session belongs to a different Meter MACS account.

abort.already_configured: This Meter MACS account is already set up.
